label: Concrete GOD_4 is necessary if existent at the standpoint
paraphrase: At every world v accessible from the standpoint w of the case profile's frame, if some concrete GOD_4 exists at v, then at every world accessible from v some concrete GOD_4 exists (the boxed conditional of NecessaryIfExistent for the case instance of G). De dicto: the GOD_4 concretum may differ between worlds. Not the bare actual conditional and not frame-global.
